youtube_title: The Gary 'Demon House': what police and caseworkers reported
body: The family said black flies swarmed their porch in the dead of winter. That's how it started, in a house in Gary. In 2011, a mother and her three children moved in, and soon, they said, they heard footsteps on the basement stairs late at night. A Gary police captain first suspected they'd made it up. After visiting the house, he said, "I am a believer." A state caseworker's report described a boy moving backward up a wall; doctors and psychologists offered other explanations. In 2012, with his bishop's approval, a Catholic priest performed exorcisms on the mother at his church. No one ever proved anything supernatural, and in 2016 the house was torn down. In 2014, the captain put it this way: "Why go where evil possibly is there?" Comment your town for the next La Porte After Dark. #Gary #LakeCounty #Indiana #TrueStory #LaPorteAfterDark
